description:
Swift Win11 Intune Workstation v2.0 (based on CIS Win11 Intune v3.0.0)
CIS recommended settings that are Custom Intune Settings.

omaSettings.description: Manages a Windows app's ability to share data between users who have installed the app.
omaSettings.displayName: Allow a Windows app to share application data between users

omaSettings.description: This policy setting determines whether users can enable the following WLAN settings: "Connect to suggested open hotspots," "Connect to networks shared by my contacts," and "Enable paid services"
omaSettings.displayName: Allow Windows to automatically connect to suggested open hotspots, to networks shared by contacts, and to hotspots offering paid services

omaSettings.description: This policy setting controls whether the Connected User Experience and Telemetry  service can automatically use an authenticated proxy to send data back to Microsoft.
omaSettings.displayName: Configure Authenticated Proxy usage for the Connected User Experience and Telemetry service

omaSettings.description: This policy is intended to provide additional security against external DMA-capable devices.
omaSettings.displayName: Enumeration policy for external devices incompatible with Kernel DMA Protection

omaSettings.description: This setting manages non-Administrator users' ability to install Windows app packages.
omaSettings.displayName: Prevent non-admin users from installing packaged Windows apps

omaSettings.description: This policy setting turns off experiences that help consumers make the most of their devices and Microsoft account.
This policy setting blocks applications from using the network to send notifications to update tiles, tile badges, toast, or raw notifications.
This policy setting turns off the location feature for the computer.
